chat.author: Jim Guichard
chat.text: by "non-AS" customer I assume this means no routing on the interface toward the customer?

chat.author: Joel Halpern
chat.text: I believe that is what the problem statement says.

chat.author: Mingqing(Michael) Huang
chat.text: my understanding it means it is not direct connected route and not eBGP route as well

chat.author: Kotikalapudi Sriram
chat.text: Yes, Jim. No routing messages. Customer prefix(es) is (are) configured into the RIB/FIB based on the configuration information registered by the customer.

chat.author: Jim Guichard
chat.text: Thanks Sriram! the reason i wanted to confirm is that in these cases i would expect the customer to be using a default route towards the provider - if SAV rules block certain sources from said customer then couldnt that cause an issue if the customer blindly follows the default in the multi-homed scenario?

chat.author: Joel Halpern
chat.text: I think that is the case we asked Sriram to describe in more detail on the list so we can tell if it has this problem.
